Reworks two hooks so the plugin meets the Claude plugin directory's policy again; no change to how the question and plan cards look or work.

- Blocked tool calls are now found by asking `$.tool.check` about a call that ended in an error, instead of a `tool.check` hook that read the engine's verdict. Calls a permission rule or the permission mode blocked still read as `not run`. A call a PreToolUse hook blocked now reads as failed again, since `$.tool.check` does not run hooks
- The question and plan cards' waiting code moved into one file with the hooks that use it. Nothing changes on screen

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
